title: One-level absorption into the second layer
statement:
Let $n, l \in \bbn$ with $l \ge 1$, and let $\mathcal{D}$ be a layer-2 datum on $n$ variables whose gates $g_0, \dots, g_{m-1}$ are DNF formulas. Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $m$ inputs — one per gate — with $\mathrm{depth}(C) \ge 1$, and consider the composite Boolean function $x \mapsto C\bigl(g_0(x), \dots, g_{m-1}(x)\bigr)$. Suppose that each gate $g_i$ admits both a DNF representation $\varphi_i$ of width at most $l$ computing the same function as $g_i$ — one in which, within every term, any two literals sharing a variable coincide and no literal is repeated — and a CNF representation of width at most $l$ computing that same function. Then there exist a layer-2 datum $\mathcal{D}'$ on $n$ variables of width at most $l$, with gates $g'_0, \dots, g'_{m'-1}$, and a Boolean circuit $C'$ on $m'$ inputs with $\mathrm{depth}(C') \le \mathrm{depth}(C) - 1$, such that for every assignment $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbf_2$,
\[
  C\bigl(g_0(x), \dots, g_{m-1}(x)\bigr) = C'\bigl(g'_0(x), \dots, g'_{m'-1}(x)\bigr).
\]
hypotheses_covered: each gate has a width-$\le l$ DNF equivalent
the DNF's terms satisfy per-term variable injectivity
each gate has a width-$\le l$ CNF equivalent
replaced:
The combined absorption step: for $c_{\mathrm{top}}$ of depth at least $1$ (with $0 < l$)
over $\mathrm{Layer2Data}$ gates having width-$l$ DNF and CNF representations, there are a
new $\mathrm{Layer2Data}'$ of width at most $l$ and a circuit $c_{\mathrm{top}}'$ of depth
at most $\mathrm{depth}\,c_{\mathrm{top}} - 1$ computing the same function. This dispatches
to the depth-1 case (giving depth $0$) and the general case (giving depth at most $1$).
